title: AND2ES — a studio site that is almost only the work, on white
note: A design studio (books, publications, identity) whose home page is just the work turning on a ring in the middle of a white screen, with a row of tiny black pills at the top and one caption pill at the bottom. There is no headline and no hero copy: the one line about the studio only shows as the preloader. Built with Nuxt, Three.js r183 and GSAP 3.15; one fullscreen canvas and a few DOM pills. Colours are #ffffff, #000000 and #e6e6e6, and every bit of text is Helvetica Neue 500 at 11px. Worth reusing: letting the images carry the whole page and keeping the type tiny and uniform so it never competes.
